title: Generated UI and View Model Semantics
authorityBoundary: This artefact defines generated UI and view-model semantics as projections of USF capability authority. It does not create component library code, form renderer code, schema generator code, screen generation, telemetry pipeline implementation, audit pipeline implementation, mobile implementation, web implementation, generated client implementation, product UI readiness, design-system readiness, generated UI readiness, production readiness, live-provider readiness, compliance readiness, monetisation readiness, or human acceptance.

derivedSurfaceRule.rule: Every generated UI screen, form, list, workflow affordance, field, error, interaction, notification, navigation item, design token use, component primitive, and platform variance must be derived from USF capability authority and must carry an explicit semantic mapping before implementation.
failClosedWhenMissing: command or query or workflow or event mapping where applicable

humanReviewBoundary.rule: Generated UI output is never product authority. Human review is required before a generated screen, component, form, copy string, route, interaction, store metadata, accessibility assertion, or release claim can be promoted.

platformVariancePolicy.rule: Mobile and web surfaces may vary layout, navigation idiom, input modality, and platform affordance, but platform variance must not change business behaviour, permission outcomes, validation rules, audit meaning, privacy classification, telemetry semantics, workflow state, or proof expectations.
allowedVariance: native capability bridge when semantically authorised

commandAndQueryModel.rule: UI clients must separate reads, mutations, workflows, validation, authorization, cache expectations, audit events, and user-facing outcomes.

behaviourKinds.description: A mutation or action request projected from USF command or workflow authority.
A read request projected from USF query or read-model authority.
A multi-step user or operator flow projected from USF workflow authority.

commandToFormMapping.rule: A command form may exist only when the form maps to a governed command or workflow and every field, action, disabled state, confirmation, failure state, and success state has semantic backing.
mustReject: error state without error taxonomy mapping

validationToFieldAndErrorMapping.rule: Field constraints, form constraints, error states, localized messages, and audit context must be projections of governed validation and error semantics.
mustReject: error disclosure exceeding safe error semantics
validation event without audit context where audit is required

auditToInteractionMapping.rule: Interactions that emit, request, display, or depend on audit events must map to governed audit semantics and privacy categories before implementation.
mustReject: audited interaction without audit event id
audit event without actor or tenant boundary
interaction logging customer data without privacy mapping

validatorRequirements.description: Reject generated screens, forms, affordances, and view models that lack capability, semantic-contract, permission, validation, audit, privacy, i18n, accessibility, telemetry, proof, or human-review mapping.
Reject UI commands or queries without semantic backing and explicit command, query, workflow, permission, validation, cache, audit, error, privacy, telemetry, and proof mappings where applicable.
Reject command forms without command, validation, permission, audit, privacy, i18n, accessibility, telemetry, and proof mappings.
Reject fields or errors without validation, error taxonomy, i18n, accessibility, privacy, audit context, and proof mappings.
Reject interactions without audit event, actor, tenant boundary, privacy, redaction, retention, telemetry correlation, and proof mappings where audit is required.

proofRequirements.description: Future proof must demonstrate that generated UI and view models are projections of governed USF capabilities and that missing semantic mappings fail closed.

Future proof must demonstrate that command forms fail without validation and audit mappings and pass with conforming command, validation, field, error, audit, privacy, i18n, accessibility, telemetry, and proof mappings.

implementationEvaluationRequirements: generated UI and view-model mappings exist for the relevant capability
validator requirements are implemented and selftested
planted-defect fixtures exist for missing generated UI, command, validation, and audit mappings
proof evidence exists for mapped and rejected generated UI cases
human review is recorded before any generated UI or product UI readiness claim
